status: CANDIDATE contract package causa-precompetition 1.0.0-candidate. Authored. Wire variants bind causa-storage v1.0.0 (causa-data e8259df) to requirements-compiled/v4.1.5 CoreEvent cases; proposed variants and commands are inputs to OD-CR-01 and are not available until the owner adopts them.
sources: proposals/r10-historical-data-compatibility/src/EventCompatibility.fs (variant table, cross-checked by the validator against the parsed contracts)

envelopeBinding.note: Which EventEnvelope record field carries which stored envelope field. The validator reads the record's actual fields from each package's 00-DOMAIN-STUBS.fs; a wire field no present record field carries is lost.

argumentConvention: A case argument of an opaque payload type carries the whole wire record (v4.1.5 E1: 'exactly the fields of their wire records'); an id-typed argument carries the payload's entity id; a labelled argument carries the wire field of that name; an unlabelled NonEmptyText carries reason; any other argument has no wire source. The discriminator and fields a schema rule pins for it are implied by the case.

eventVariants.name: ExtensionAttached
eventVariants.note: v4.1.5 CoreEvent.ExtensionAttached has no causa-storage v1.0.0 form: v1.0.0 has no extension namespace (CONTRACT §13.5). The command boundary refuses AttachExtension (CMD-DOM-29) so it is never decided.

eventVariants.name: InvestigationDetailsRevised
eventVariants.note: INV-023, INV-034, INV-035. Recorded in the StartInvestigation command group when a question is entered at start, and alone for later edits. The earlier values stay in history.

eventVariants.name: ObservationRevised
eventVariants.note: INV-025 (source reference), INV-035 (edit keeps the id).

eventVariants.name: HypothesisRevised
eventVariants.note: INV-035 (edit keeps the id). Statement and mechanism (INV-026, INV-011).

eventVariants.name: EvidenceRevised
eventVariants.note: INV-027 label, INV-028 source reference, INV-029 URL; descriptive metadata only. The original content stays immutable (R3; corrections of content are EvidenceSuperseded, OD-CR-06).

eventVariants.name: EvidenceRelationshipRevised
eventVariants.note: OD-INDY-23 (3) reassess; INV-030 update, INV-031, INV-038.

eventVariants.name: EvidenceRelationshipWithdrawn
eventVariants.note: OD-INDY-23 (3) withdraw; a withdrawal records its own reason (INV-038 note).

commands.name: Create investigation

inputs.source: ui:INV-002; blank title falls back to the problem statement (FIELD-MAPPING.md InvestigationStarted.title)
derived: new UUID for the initial observation
session: RequestContext.Now truncated to milliseconds at the command boundary (CONTRACT §2.9)

preconditions: connected with write permission (IF41-WIRE Connect)
target is a working copy: Writable.ofAddress accepts WorkspaceAddress.workingCopy only (v4.1.5 W1)
no investigation with this id exists in the working copy
commands.idempotency: CommandId is the correlationId; a re-submitted CommandId returns Decision.Duplicate and writes nothing.
commands.authorization: Writable working copy and repository write permission stated by GitHub (04-IF41-ERRORS).
commands.persistenceEffect: Msg.CreateRequested starts SaveMachine.InitialNew in Unsaved (or Offline); StorageCodec.EncodeNew produces the three-file set; durable only after read-back (PS-VERIFIED).
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-INV-CREATE-01 accepted command emits exactly InvestigationStarted at version 1
T-IMPL-CMD-INV-CREATE-02 each validationErrors row refuses and writes nothing

commands.name: Activate investigation
preconditions: lifecycle is draft, awaitingEvidence, awaitingVerification or archived (STATE-TRANSITION-TABLES §1)
commands.idempotency: Decision.Duplicate on a repeated CommandId; activating an active investigation is an illegal transition, not a no-op.

commands.name: Edit investigation metadata (title, problem statement, question)
preconditions: investigation exists in a working copy
at least one value differs from the current one
commands.idempotency: Decision.Duplicate on a repeated CommandId; an unchanged revision is refused (NO_CHANGE) so history holds no empty edits.
commands.persistenceEffect: SaveInput.Edit; needs causa-storage 1.1.0 (v1.0.0 has no rename/edit event, CONTRACT §16).
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-INV-EDIT-02 earlier values remain in history (INV-035)

commands.name: Add observation

inputs.source: ui:INV-025 (proposed; a second event in the same command group)

preconditions: investigation exists in a working copy
resultEvents: ObservationRevised (only when INV-025 is entered; proposed)

commands.name: Edit observation
preconditions: observation exists
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-OBS-EDIT-01 id kept, earlier text in history (INV-035)

commands.name: Add hypothesis

inputs.source: ui:INV-011 (optional on record, CF-03 A; mapping OD-CR-05)

preconditions: investigation exists in a working copy
commands.authorization: Writable working copy; agent actors may not record hypotheses (CONTRACT §5.3, D-004).

commands.name: Edit hypothesis

inputs.source: ui:INV-011 (required when edited in detail, CF-03 A)

preconditions: hypothesis exists
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-HYP-EDIT-01 id kept, earlier text in history (INV-035)

commands.name: Add evidence

inputs.source: NO INPUT PATH: required wire enum with no catalog field (OD-CR-02)
ui:INV-028; required on the wire but optional in the catalog (OD-CR-03)

preconditions: investigation exists in a working copy
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-EVD-ADD-02 unsafe URL refused and never rendered as a link

commands.name: Edit evidence details
preconditions: evidence exists and is not superseded
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-EVD-EDIT-01 id kept; content unchanged; earlier label in history

commands.name: Link evidence to hypothesis

inputs.source: ui:INV-031 (supports, contradicts in v1.0.0; consistent-with and inconclusive need 1.1.0)
ui:INV-038 (required at the command boundary although nullable on the wire)

preconditions: evidence and hypothesis exist (INV-030: link to a non-existent target is refused)
no current relationship for the pair (OD-INDY-23 (3); the existing one is named in the refusal)

validationErrors.rule: exactly one option selected; no default

commands.idempotency: Decision.Duplicate on a repeated CommandId; a second link for the same pair is refused, not merged.
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-REL-LINK-01 shown on both evidence and hypothesis after reload (INV-044)
T-IMPL-CMD-REL-LINK-02 second link for the pair refused

commands.name: Revise a relationship (reassess)
preconditions: relationship exists and is current (not withdrawn)
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-REL-REVISE-01 earlier assessment and provenance remain in history

commands.name: Withdraw a relationship

inputs.source: ui:INV-038 (a withdrawal records its own reason)

preconditions: relationship exists and is current
commands.idempotency: Decision.Duplicate on a repeated CommandId; withdrawing a withdrawn relationship is an illegal transition.
tests: T-IMPL-CMD-REL-WITHDRAW-01 pair may be linked again after withdrawal; history keeps both

commands.name: Assess a hypothesis (mark plausible or supported, falsify, reopen)

inputs.source: user-entered reason (no catalog field: not required by the approved UI scope)
selection; non-empty for markSupported, markWeakened, falsify and reopen

preconditions: STATE-TRANSITION-TABLES §2 from-state

validationErrors.rule: nonEmptyUuidList where the schema requires it

commands.name: Weaken or supersede a hypothesis
commands.persistenceEffect: Read only: these events replay (EV-013, EV-015) but v4.1.5 defers their commands ('commands for the 22 added event kinds').

commands.name: Record conclusion

inputs.source: NO INPUT PATH: required wire enum with no catalog field (OD-CR-04)
empty list (INV-032 asks for no causes)

preconditions: investigation exists in a working copy
does not resolve the investigation (INV-032 note)
commands.persistenceEffect: SaveInput.Edit. The wire event exists in v1.0.0; only the command is missing from v4.1.5 CoreCommand.

commands.name: Reopen investigation
preconditions: lifecycle resolved or closed

commands.name: Save workspace changes
preconditions: session in Unsaved (SM-SAVE)

validationErrors.rule: unlisted (state, input) pair fails closed (state-machine-contracts.json invalidTransition)

commands.idempotency: One write per WriteMarker {Session; Sequence}; reconciliation reads the marker before any retry (UnknownOutcome).

commands.name: Load workspace (list investigations)
preconditions: connected

commands.name: Open (load) investigation
preconditions: the RouteTarget resolves to a listed workspace (07-IF41-VIEW RouteTarget)

validationErrors.rule: files do not verify; fail closed

commands.authorization: Read permission. Only a working-copy load creates a save session (T-L03 as replaced by v4.1.5).

commands.name: Import (open) a historical catalog case
preconditions: ListingTarget.ActiveCatalog derives the workspace from catalog/active.json
commands.authorization: Read only: Writable refuses a catalog (W1); shown as read-only with admissibility not evaluated (OD-HC-04 A) until the kernel refuses the 35 inadmissible fixtures (OD-HC-03 A).
commands.persistenceEffect: No write. Copying a catalog case into a working copy is not specified by any approved requirement and is not part of this contract.

commands.name: Export investigation (unsaved changes during a conflict)
preconditions: SM-CONFLICT offers ExportMine
commands.persistenceEffect: Hands the local commands to the user; writes nothing. A general export is not in the approved requirements.

commands.name: Record proposal
commands.authorization: The only command an agent actor may issue (CONTRACT §5.3, D-004).

commands.name: Attach extension
commands.note: causa-storage v1.0.0 has no extension namespace (CONTRACT §13.5); Decide returns UnsupportedSemantics and nothing is written.
